sources.label: DENR DAO 2004-24 — Philippine Native Species Protection in Site Development
sources.description: Implements PD 705 regarding protection of native tree species during site development. Lists protected native Philippine species.

sources.label: RA 9147: Wildlife Resources Conservation Act — Protected Native Species
sources.description: Protects native Philippine wildlife and plant species. Lists endangered and threatened native species relevant to site planning.

sources.label: PD 705: Revised Forestry Code — Protection of Native Forest Species
sources.description: Governs the protection, preservation, and utilization of native forest species including premium hardwood species (Narra, Molave, etc.).
